This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Responsibilities

Job Description:



- Support senior team members on assigned technical projects as determined by the business unit.
- Help identify and troubleshoot technical issues, providing support and suggesting solutions.
- Assist with maintaining and updating hardware, software, and other technical systems.
- Participate in team activities by attending team meetings, learn about project methodologies, and collaborate effectively with colleagues.
- Actively engage in learning about new technologies and methodologies relevant to work.
- Fulfill tasks and responsibilities assigned by a supervisor in a timely and efficient manner.
- Participate in periodic reviews to share updates and incorporate feedback on assigned projects/initiatives.

Education & Experience



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
- Familiarity with programming languages or technical tools relevant to the role.

Knowledge & Skills



- Linux system administration and command-line environments across multiple enterprise Linux distributions.
- AI model training, inference, benchmarking, performance characterization, and optimization.
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
- Basic programming or scripting knowledge (e.g., Python, Java, C++).
- Strong interest in high-tech and a passion for learning.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
- Time management skills and working with strict deadlines.
- A collaborative, solution-focused mindset and overall sense of urgency.

Nice-to-have Skills



- Basic knowledge on GPU accelerator technologies, memory hierarchies, and AI software stacks including CUDA, NCCL, and related ecosystem tools.
- Basic knowledge on high performance computing (HPC), MPI and Linux clusters

Impact/Scope



- University students actively enrolled in a university/college/institution pursuing a Bachelor's degree in a technical area of study, and who typically works during school breaks and then returns to their university. While this applies to most interns, there may be opportunities for full-time students to work as part-time interns during the school year in some countries.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

jd:
At Sun Life, we’re driven by our Purpose: helping our  Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.   

 Our student and new graduate programs offer a chance to explore Sun Life from the inside. You’ll make a difference in the lives of our customers and communities, while building the skills and experience that allow you to grow in a meaningful and rewarding way.

 Job Description: 
 The Student, AI Developer will support the design, development, and testing of AI-enabled capabilities for the Governance by Design (GbyD) platform. Working alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and business partners, the successful candidate will help build and enhance solutions that streamline governance processes, improve user experiences, and explore the practical application of Generative AI within an enterprise environment. 
 This role provides an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with modern software development, AI technologies, cloud platforms, workflow automation, and enterprise product delivery while contributing to a strategic transformation initiative.

 What do you need to succeed? 

 Preferred Skills 
 
• Knowledge of Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript through coursework, projects, or previous co-op experience 
• Interest in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging technologies 
• Understanding of software development fundamentals and APIs 
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative development practices 
• Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
• Ability to learn quickly and collaborate effectively within a team Qualifications 
 
• Currently enrolled in a Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI, or related program 
• Upper-year undergraduate student (3rd or 4th year preferred) 
• Demonstrated interest in software development, AI, automation, or cloud technologies 
• Experience with academic, personal, or co-op projects involving programming or data analysis 
• Strong communication and teamwork skills 
 Nice-to-Have Technologies 
 Exposure to any of the following technologies would be considered an asset: 
 
• AWS Bedrock or similar AI platforms 
• Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) 
• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts 
• Prompt engineering fundamentals 
• Vector databases 
• API development and integrations 
• ServiceNow or Microsoft Teams integrations 
• AI testing and evaluation approaches 
• Knowledge of governance, risk, compliance, or enterprise architecture concepts 
 What will you do? 
 
• Assist in building and testing AI-enabled features and workflow capabilities 
• Support development activities using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and cloud-based tools 
• Help evaluate and improve AI-generated outputs, prompts, and user experiences 
• Participate in application integration, testing, troubleshooting, and quality assurance activities 
• Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to understand user needs and requirements 
• Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives 
• Research emerging AI technologies and help identify opportunities to apply them within enterprise workflows 
 Key Outcomes: 
 The student will support the team in developing and enhancing AI-enabled capabilities that improve governance workflows and user experiences. Areas of contribution may include: 
 
• AI-powered summarization and insight generation 
• Identification of content gaps and improvement opportunities within submissions 
• Support for workflow automation and reviewer decision-support capabilities 
• Guided submission experiences and dynamic question flows 
• Integration of AI capabilities with enterprise platforms and workflows 
• Testing, evaluation, and refinement of AI-generated outputs 
• User experience enhancements across end-to-end governance processes 
 What Makes This Opportunity Unique 
 
• This role offers an opportunity to work on a strategic enterprise initiative exploring the application of AI within governance and risk management processes. The student will gain hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, cloud platforms, workflow automation, and product development practices while collaborating with experienced professionals across business and technology teams. 
• The successful candidate will contribute to real-world AI solutions that help improve efficiency, transparency, and decision-making, while developing practical skills that are increasingly valuable in the evolving AI and software engineering landscape
 What's in it for you? 
 
• Gain practical experience designing and delivering enterprise AI solutions while learning how Generative AI, cloud technologies, workflow automation, and governance processes come together to solve real business challenges. The successful candidate will work directly with experienced practitioners and contribute to the development of innovative AI-enabled capabilities used across the organization. 
• This role is ideal for a student who is curious about AI and software engineering and is looking for an opportunity to apply classroom learning in a real-world enterprise setting. The student will gain exposure to Generative AI, workflow automation, cloud technologies, product delivery, and user-centered solution design while contributing to a highly visible strategic initiative.  

 The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted for. The Base Pay which you will be considered for will vary depending on the Campus program you are selected for.

 Eligible Sun Life employees for various Campus Graduate programs will also participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance

 Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

 Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com .

 We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

 We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

 We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 Job Category: 
Temporary Employee 
 Posting End Date: 
18/10/2026

At Manulife John Hancock, we believe in investing in the future – starting with you. Our Technology Co-op Program is your launchpad to success, offering the support, structure, and exciting opportunities you need to thrive and make your mark. Our co-op program offers more than just experience; you'll join a vibrant community, participate in engaging events, and benefit from personalized mentorship.   

 As a Data Engineer Co-op, you’ll gain hands-on experience building and supporting the data systems that power business insights and decision-making. You’ll work with modern data tools and platforms to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and workflows, helping transform raw data into meaningful, actionable information. Join a supportive team and experience a values-first culture where your career development and well-being are prioritized alongside your job impact. We offer multiple roles within this program, providing support from our diverse, passionate, and talented technology teams. You’ll receive guidance from experienced engineers while gaining exposure to data architecture, data processing, and analytics workflows in an enterprise environment.   

 We are currently looking for a highly motivated student to join us in our Waterloo, Ontario, Canada office for a 4-month co-op , running from January 5 th – April 22 nd  2027 . This is a hybrid position, where you are expected to be in the office Tuesday-Thursday, with the opportunity to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.    

 Position Responsibilities:   

• Contribute to a team of data engineers focused on building reliable, scalable data systems   

• Support the development and maintenance of data pipelines and workflows   

• Assist with data ingestion, transformation, and preparation for reporting and analytics use cases   

• Collaborate with engineering and business teams to understand data requirements and support solutions   

 Required Qualifications:   

• Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field   

• Experience with SQL and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java)   

• Interest in data engineering concepts, including data pipelines and data processing   

• Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git, Bitbucket)   

• Strong communication skills and willingness to learn in a collaborative environment   

 Preferred Qualifications:   

• Exposure to data tools (e.g., Spark, Databricks, or similar technologies)   

• Basic understanding of ETL processes, data modeling, or data warehousing   

• Familiarity with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud)   

• Understanding of large-scale data processing concepts   

 When you join our team:   

• We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.    

• We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.    

• As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.    

• As part of our co-op program, you will gain early access to Manulife John Hancock’s premier early talent program, GRO, tailored to graduating students! This program is designed to launch your career with the support, structure, and opportunities you need to thrive.   

 Application instructions:    

•  Submit your resume, cover letter, academic transcript, and work term evaluation (if any) in one PDF file.    

   Please note the salary range is expected to be between $52,650 CAD to $70,200 CAD .   

 The actual salary will vary depending on local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience, and education/training. The annual salary will be pro-rated based on the length of the work-term   

 #LI-Hybrid
